title: Strange Silk
description: Tens of thousands of particles fall through a chaotic flow and settle into a strange attractor. The whole screen is a map of that flow's two parameters, so dragging a finger bends the equation and the cloud reorganises under your hand — silky sheets of light that keep developing like a long exposure whenever you hold still. Two fingers turn, pinch and roll it. Eight attractors, each with its own colour of music: Aizawa, Lorenz, Thomas, Halvorsen, Rössler, Burke–Shaw, Dadras and Four-Wing.
